nodes.input: Non-safety-critical roadside information: lane status is clear. Return the lane status as one lowercase word only.

nodes.input_template: The upstream lane-status token is '{normalized_status}'. Return exactly that lowercase token and nothing else.

workflow.normalization: Unicode lowercase; retain ASCII letters only

correctness.intermediate: continuous and migration-source generated token IDs, decoded text, and normalized status must match exactly
correctness.state: state canonical bytes, embedded content hash, immutable identities, completed/remaining DAG, and next-node identity must validate exactly
correctness.final: continuous and restored generated token IDs and decoded text must match exactly; normalized final output must equal clear

must_transfer: remaining node IDs and DAG edges

kv_cache.reason: the chosen node boundary consumes the serialized upstream output, not a token-continuation KV cache; the target rebuilds the stage-2 prompt

tensor_state.reason: no downstream tensor crosses this application-level node boundary

target_preexisting_immutable_resources: processor/tokenizer/config files under the pinned local model repository
rebuildable: stage-2 prompt from normalized upstream output
state_contract.rebuild_cost_accounting: prompt rebuild and tokenization measured separately; target model load measured separately
state_contract.transport_cost: not measured; same-host file visibility only
state_contract.completeness_boundary: complete for this declared two-node application workflow, not a complete generic model runtime or arbitrary workflow migration state

paths.continuous: one independent child process loads the base once and executes both nodes
paths.recovered: source child loads base, executes node 1, atomically saves state and exits; a separately spawned target child reads only the declared state plus immutable plan/model/code resources, loads base, rebuilds node 2, and finishes

conditions.load_label: process-first load with unspecified OS page-cache state
conditions.failure_policy: retain the first configuration or execution failure; only a documented configuration correction may be rerun and must use a versioned output

resource_budget.derivation: up to three unrecoverable v1.1 warmup children plus one warmup and three measurements times one continuous process plus one source process plus one target process in v1.2
